purpose: Research-resolved picks for HotSpawn CS2 pick'em fixtures that featured market picks cannot resolve (low-tier / unpriced matches), per user request: try HLTV first, then esportsbooks and esports betting lines. HotSpawn crowd pick percentages are NEVER used as probability inputs (discovery and settlement only). Every fact below carries the official page it was read from and the UTC read time.
protocol: Layer M (market): a verified external bookmaker/exchange price (Pinnacle, Bovada, Melbet, Kalshi, or the Thunderpick coefficients bo3.gg publishes per fixture) with confirmed participant alignment resolves the pick, exactly like the featured picks. Research is not used to override a market pick.

Layer R (research): no external price exists -> read HLTV (ranking, analytics page, head-to-head, form, roster/stand-in notes), then esportsbooks / esports betting-line aggregators (egamersworld odds widget, Polymarket listings, bo3.gg analytics, Kalshi event pages). An own line is originated from those documented facts; each number on the site links to its source page.
Layer O (model): no market and no usable research -> the project's Valve VRS / own-Elo originated line, labelled as such.
Layer U (unresolved): nothing defensible -> pick left blank and published on the Unresolved picks + limitations page. Never inferred, never filled in.
origin_formula: Own originated line per match = a documented probability derived from the research facts listed per fixture (HLTV rank gap, head-to-head, recent form, roster notes, any published bookmaker/aggregator quote with its no-vig normalization p_i = (1/odds_i) / sum_j(1/odds_j)). Each originated probability is stated explicitly below with the facts it uses. Estimates only — not guarantees.
